exposure: pneumatic injection of hyaluronic acid with a jet volumetric remodeling (JVR) system
outcome: clinical assessment with a validated scar scale
cohort: Two patients with striae distensae on their left and right breasts and abdomen were included.
finding: Pneumatic injection of hyaluronic acid with a JVR system was found to be a well-tolerated and effective therapy for striae, showing significant improvement (45.71% at 6 months, 42.88% at 15 months) and high patient satisfaction.
